chapters.title: Add to your faith
chapters.summary: God's power has given us everything for life and godliness. Add to faith virtue, knowledge, self-control, patience, godliness, kindness and love. Prophecy came from God as people were moved by the Holy Spirit.

chapters.title: False teachers
chapters.summary: False teachers will arise, greedy and arrogant. God judged the ancient world but rescued Noah and Lot, and He knows how to rescue the godly.

chapters.title: The Lord is patient
chapters.summary: Scoffers ask where His coming is. With the Lord a day is as a thousand years. He is not slow, but patient, not wanting any to perish. Grow in grace and knowledge.
